title: Self-check list before release
label: 08-Pre-Publication Checklist
markdown:
# Self-check list before release

|  |
| --- |
| Does it directly or indirectly promote goods or services, or is it advertising, commercial advertising or general public information? |
| Are the brands included in this list not used in terms such as words, and in their casecases, spaces, hyphens or Chinese/English variants? |
| Is there a “national level, highest level, best” or disguised absolute, ranking, unique expression? |
| Are all functional, effectiveness, safety, qualifications, awards, patents, customer and cooperative information consistent with the current situation? |
| Are all the data, rankings, surveys, quotations true, accurate and indicating the source, time, scope, calibre and validity? |
| Do you have authorization to use customer names, Logo, cases, portraits, sound, evaluation, copyright material and third-party trademarks? |
| Will competition be comparable, verifiable, non-demeaning and detrimental to the goodwill of others? |
| Are prices, promotions, inventories, incentives, countdowns and restrictions true and significant disclosure? |
| Are they in industries that require advertising censorship or special qualifications, and have the necessary clearances been obtained and issued strictly in accordance with the approvals? |
| Is Internet advertising recognized and closed with one key, and does front end, drop page, jump link and live feed? |
| The title, cover, pictures, subtitles, audio, footnotes, comment area tops, 2-D code and AI production files meet the requirements of this list? |
